Generated equip rule joins Pay 2 life and {2} in the wrong order and punctuation.

card_data_diagnostics.comparison_boundary: The detailed comparison checks generated card information against the available reference corpus. Equivalent rendering differences are not promoted to defects.

modified_change_scope.boundary: Presentation/metadata includes generated text, hints, filter descriptions, imports and formatting. It is not automatically gameplay proof. Eleven exact non-executable token-equivalent hunks are cleared only by the versioned v2 policy; SwordsmanSharpScoundrel is executable because its attacker-controller predicate was removed.

postgresql_scope_reconciliation.boundary: PostgreSQL remains truth for product identity, Oracle text and legality. The approved SSH fingerprint was matched and both queries ran in a read-only transaction.

runtime_catalog.unsupported_identity_source: 133 exact activation restrictions plus the exact Planetarium and Mandate quarantines

transition_card_nominal_tests.boundary: An exact card reference plus a passing upstream test is nominal regression evidence. It does not prove that every transition hunk or product-facing interaction is semantically correct.

upstream_card_data_verifier.boundary: VerifyCardDataTest proves card loading and structural/card-data invariants. It is not gameplay semantic proof.

upstream_focused_tests.boundary: Passing changed-scenario tests is regression evidence; only explicit name/class references count as nominal card proof.

nominal_reference_inventory.interpretation: Exact reference inventory locates nominal tests; Maven results establish whether those selected test classes passed.
